_about: The repository settings the Commons expects, with the reason for each (pattern from the GitHub Repos Asset Catalogue). The weekly Repository health workflow compares GitHub with this file and keeps one issue up to date with any drift. It never changes a setting: only an owner does, in Settings.

visibility: The Commons is a public good, built in the open
has_issues: Contact form, backlog and corrections arrive as issues
has_discussions: Questions and ideas that are not yet work items
has_wiki: Documentation lives in docs/ and is reviewed through pull requests, so a wiki would drift
web_commit_signoff_required: Every web edit carries the author's sign-off
homepage: The repository links to the portal

secret_scanning: Free on public repositories; catches leaked credentials
secret_scanning_push_protection: Blocks a push that contains a credential
dependabot_security_updates: Fixes for known vulnerabilities arrive as pull requests
private_vulnerability_reporting: SECURITY.md promises a private way to report security problems

main_protected: Protect the main branch: require a pull request and the CI check, and block force pushes and deletion

required: Forms and workflows apply these labels; GitHub skips a label that doesn't exist
